notes.title: Crooked Waters 1.0.1 hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have noticed that a few issues regarding hosting and joining lobbies have stuck around since last update. This hotfix will address these issues:

[FIXED] Fixed an issue where players would not properly disconnect from a lobby after leaving.
[FIXED] Fixed an issue where players could accidentally create ‘ghost’ lobbies that caused other players to crash when joined.
[FIXED] Corrected lobby handling when joining a lobby with incorrect data.
[FIXED] Fixed a bug where players would not disconnect immediately from a lobby when the host leaves.

notes.title: Crooked Waters 1.0.1 changelog
notes.notes:
Avast!

Since Crooked Waters: Conquest has been released we've been collecting a lot of feedback and comments of the community.
We've noticed that there were issues for some players that weren't able to connect to other players' lobbies. We have addressed this issue as high priority and greatly improved the connectivity of Crooked Waters.

Besides this we've made some minor improvements.

We will continue to collect feedback and keep improving the game. 

[UPDATED] Increased compass range in Conquest, so an objective will be shown on the compass on the start of a match.
[UPDATED] Added a more noticable "ready" button for clients in the lobby screen.

[FIXED] Added relay servers as a backup if regular NAT punchtrough failes.
[FIXED] Fixed issue where remaining players weren't able to finish a Conquest match after a player leaves the match.
[FIXED] Fixed issue where players could fall through the scene on the starting island when rotating.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.10f2 changelog
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32444331/e31a421e70a3a2cc5d4206c02078f4349b5e27c2.png

Avast!

Today marks another step forward towards the release of Crooked Waters 1.0.
We have merged our 1.0 project into the live project. What this means is that we don't have to work in two seperate versions of Crooked Waters anymore.
All the updates and tweaks we have added to the live build are now also applied in the 1.0 project and vice versa all additions and tweaks are now added to the live project. This doesn't necessarily mean that everything will be available for you guys. But it is a step forward for us now the major hurdle of maintaining a live build while developing an update has been made a lot easier to maintain. 

As I said, with the merge a lot of improvements that we made in the 1.0 project have been merged as well into the live build. 
However, we are aware that there are a few new bugs introduced because of the merge. But in our opinion these are not significant enough to block the update.

One major improvement that is worth mentioning is in the networking between the different players.
We have drastically improved our network synchronization code which results in better and more accurate synchronization of objects between all players.

[NEW] Added ghost hands when interacting with fixed interactable items.

[UPDATE] Drastically improved network synchronization accuracy.
[UPDATE] Improved overall performance
[UPDATE] Improved hand pivoting when grabbing a winchhandle. 
[UPDATE] Improved speed settings of solo challenge ship.
[UPDATE] Ropes are no longer realtime updated.

[FIXED] Bug in solo challenge where no more target ships would spawn.
[FIXED] Bug where the small ship's sail did not have collision with the mast.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.9f7 changelog
notes.notes:
Avast!

This week's update introduces our new water system. Visually it has improved a lot due to it's using realtime reflection now from the sky.
Technically it has improved as well since it gives us more flexibility on how the water should behave i.e. the waves are more realistic and we have more control on the wave height etc. We still want to improve a lot but we think it has become much better already.

Besides that we fixed more bugs and continue to do so. 
As mentioned in previous updates, we are still working hard on our 1.0.0 release and are getting closer to a product that is ready to show to you guys.


[NEW] Implemented new water visuals.

[UPDATE] Make anchor releasing sound less loud.
[UPDATE] Improve ship collision behaviour.

[FIXED] Player spawns in the water when trying to spawn on player-island.
[FIXED] Cannon barrel fuse can be lighted by any part of the botefeux instead of only the fuse part.
[FIXED] Usernames are no longer visible when a player dies.
[FIXED] Crowsnest and top mast pole no longer has player collision on climb.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.9f6 changelog
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32444331/7ead5a533fb7aeffdd69f3cfea4780bb643cb4c7.png

Greetings!

This week’s update introduces player damage to the game in preparation of update 1.0.0.  It includes personal weapons and player death all available now, however the potential of this update will be fully met when the big update hits. This comes with a few new mechanics which will be explained here. 

As of this update we have introduced personal weapons. Each player starts with a pistol and a cutlass in their item-belt upon spawning. 
Pistols can be used to fire at players from a distance. To fire a pistol a player must load the pistol with a bullet, and pulling back the hammer. Bullets can be found in the bullet pouch attached to your item-belt.
Swords can be used in close-range combat. Swinging your sword around causes a wind-effect to follow it. The wind-effect indicates whether the sword is able to hit. A player drops items from his hands on death, while items in their item-belt will remain when respawning.

[NEW] Added kickback when firing cannons.
[NEW] Added new Cutlass weapon.
[NEW] Added new Pistol weapon.
[NEW] Added player damage, allowing players to take damage from other players.
[NEW] Added player death and respawning.
[NEW] Added bullet pouch, containing bullets for pistols.
[UPDATE] Made preparations for island exploration.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.9f5 changelog
notes.notes:

Last week we've released the devlog which contains more detailed information about the upcoming 1.0 "Conquest" update. We hope you guys see as much potential as we do in our effort to reduce the amount of required players needed to play a match. To prevent us from hiding in our dark developer rooms working on the 1.0 update, we've introduced the bugfix Friday in our workflow. If you have an idea, suggestion or want to report a bug please let us know on the official Crooked Waters Discord server:
https://discord.gg/m8yweFx

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.9f2 changelog
notes.notes:
Avast!

We are on our way to Crooked Waters 1.0. Along the road to 1.0 we are releasing intermediate updates which will support the build of 1.0.

We've improved and added some additional sound effects, reworked the sandbank system and improved the look of the starter island. notes.title: Alpha 0.9.9f1 changelog
notes.notes:
Greetings landlubbers!

This update is the first update following the official early access release of Crooked Waters! This patch we have implemented a few much requested features from the community and a few changes to solo play. We have expanded the options for movement controls in the settings menu. You can now choose whether you want smooth turning or snap turning with a wide array of snap angles.  

[NEW] Each multiplayer ship now has a capstan on the front deck which can be used to lower or raise an anchor. The anchor can be used to stop the ship or make sharp turns.
[NEW] Implemented smooth turning. Smooth turning can be enabled in the settings menu.
[NEW] Added optional click turning.
[NEW] Added extra snap angles for snap turning; you can now choose to turn with either 90, 45, 30, 20, 10 or 5 degrees. 
[FIXED] Roundshot damage is lowered, increasing the amount of hits needed to sink a ship in multiplayer.
[FIXED] Oculus snap turning has been fixed and now works accordingly. 
[FIXED] Corrected an issue where cannon fuses would fire regardless if the cannon was loaded or not.
[FIXED] Bumping target boats in solo play does not get you stuck anymore.
[UPDATED] Completing a solo game automatically restarts a game after a while, this can be stopped by quitting back to the lobby using the arm UI.
[UPDATED] The solo play mode time is drastically lowered to two minutes making the games quicker and actually challenging. The old highscores will be removed this week to make it fair.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.9 changelog
notes.notes:
Avast!

The last few weeks we've been preparing for release working on this update. In this update we've implemented a tutorial which makes it easier for new players to get comfortable on the ship.
Also we've added a singleplayer mode where the goal is to get the highest score on the leaderboard by sinking ship targets. 

Besides these new features we've fixed a lot of bugs that were still in the game.

Here’s a detailed rundown of what has been added, updated or fixed this patch;

[NEW] A tutorial that covers basic interaction.
[NEW] A solo pratise mode with a highscore system.
[NEW] Added more sounds to the tavern and ship.
[NEW] Added sails sound effects when sails are alligned with the wind direction.
[NEW] Added haptics when interacting with winches.
[FIXED] Climbing offset for all movement types.
[FIXED] Bug where items would dissapear for other players when dropping them.
[UPDATED] Lighting in the tavern has been improved.
[UPDATED] Random characters stay the same when going in-game.
[UPDATED] Improved ship collision.
[UPDATED] Improved loading transitions.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.5 changelog
notes.notes:
Avast!

However we're getting closer everytime to a stable build, there were still a few nasty game-breaking bugs.
Until now! With this update we've fixed multiple issues that caused the players to be unable to finish the game. 

Here’s a detailed rundown of what has been added, updated or fixed this patch;


[FIXED] The major cause of the issue that makes the game unresponsive and forces the player to restart has been identified and solved.
[FIXED] The large offset when climbing the nets to the crow's nest has been fixed.
[FIXED] The spyglass using other player's spyglass camera to display.
[FIXED] Clashing between belt and bucket interaction when deposit/withdraw an item from either has been fixed. 

[UPDATED] The steeringwheel has been completely rewritten and is more rigid and less error prone.
[UPDATED] LOD-system is subdivided in more smaller groups which gives more control over what LOD to show.
[UPDATED] Attach points to other players' hands are positioned better.
[UPDATED] Small visual updates in the battle scene.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.4 changelog
notes.notes:
Avast!

The team has been hard at work to improve the overall performance of the game the past few weeks. This led to the surfacing of a few nasty network bugs which took our team a lot of effort and digging in code to solve, which is why the communication with the community has been a little silent. These implementations create a more stable and performant base of the game, which enables us to add new features more easily in the future. With the bugs solved we can open a new testing window for you all to test the game. 

Here’s a detailed rundown of what has been added, updated of fixed this patch;

[UPDATED] A lot of the network code has been updated and this leads to a significant increase in performance as well as resolving a couple of bugs; namely clients displacing on the ship.
[UPDATED] The container system has been overhauled, giving players the ability to place items back into the containers.
[UPDATED] The tavern’s lighting has been overhauled.
 
[FIXED] The stairs to the lower deck has received an overhaul regarding collision. Players should no longer get stuck on invisible edges when walking up the stairs.
[FIXED] A small visual bug that allowed some players to see incorrect wind visuals has been corrected.

[NEW] A new LOD-system has been added. The new system makes rendering the map easier on your GPU by rendering only parts of the map that the player is on. This leads to an overall increase in FPS and lower loading times.
[NEW] A new character controller has been introduced. This makes other players look better ingame with better placement of a characters’ limbs.  
[NEW] A rework of the ship’s accessibility made it possible for players to finally walk on the front pillar of the ship located on the bow. 
[NEW] A vote kick system has been introduced in the lobby scene. Players can initiate a vote kick on a certain player and other players can vote on whether or not to kick this player. 
[NEW] A new build validator system was introduced in this update. This will resolve the problem of players being stuck in the main menu.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.3 changelog
notes.notes:
Yarr!

The past two weeks we have been hard at work at improving the overall quality of the game. The game should be a lot more responsive and a lot of nasty bugs with players joining game and lobbies are gone!
Also a completely new lobby has been added to the game, let us know what you think of it!

Here is a detailed rundown on the updates:

[NEW] Added new lobby; tavern.
[NEW] A slider to control the volume of the voice chat has been added to the settings. So you can mute those pesky teammates if needed.

[FIXED] The loading time between going from a lobby to a game has drastically been reduced.
[FIXED] Lightmapping data is now properly applied ingame, resulting in an increase in performance and a better looking environment.
[FIXED] Ship floor collisions have been updated, you should no longer be able to fall through the floor randomly anymore!
[FIXED] The lobby finder won’t display lobbies that don’t exist anymore.
[FIXED] Returning back to the lobby after completing a game no longer randomly crashes.
[FIXED] Default volume levels have been corrected. No longer will your ears be plagued by extremely loud sea sounds!
[FIXED] Quickturn on the touchpad has been improved and is easier to execute.
[FIXED] Game sounds on the start island will now play correctly.
[FIXED] The game will now start after 90 seconds, regardless if players are still loading. This will fix a lot of issues with players stuck on the starting island.
[FIXED] Network code improvements. 
[FIXED] Minor bug fixes.

[UPDATED] The lobby user interface has begun a rework, starting this update it will undergo a process of reworking, this could take a few updates. 
[UPDATED] A character’s arm and leg movement have been improved.
[UPDATED] The doors in the captain’s quarters have temporarily been fixed. They no longer will cause the ship to crash.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.2 changelog
notes.notes:
Ahoy!

We have learned a lot from your feedback last time. We made improvements based on this. 

It won't be that easy anymore to get your ship beached on the shore as we will gently push you back into the water.
Also we have changed the height of the sails. So instead of maneuvering your ship with your sixth sense and pure luck, you can now enjoy the view and be a functional helmsman at the same time!

Furthermore we did more additional improvements and bug fixes:

[NEW] Added an announcement board to the lobby which shows the testing timeframes.
[NEW] Added a screen on the starter island that shows who has already loaded the match.
[NEW] Added touchpad locomotion.
[NEW] Added preferences in settings to choose locomotion type.
[UPDATED] Lobbies can now be hosted privately and people can only join through invite.
[UPDATED] Improved ship maneuverability.
[UPDATED] Left hand radial menu Quit button needs to be pressed 3 seconds and returns haptic feedback.
[FIXED] Issue with inversed movement when trying to climb in the crowsnest is fixed.
[FIXED] Voice chat channel in the lobby is now shared instead of per team.
[FIXED] Fixed crashing ship when a player glitches through the ship.
[FIXED] Decreased belt lookat angle before belt freezes.
[FIXED] Opening SteamVR overlay during a match will not pause the game anymore.
[FIXED] Minor bug fixes.


Arrgh!
